sentences.text:
The family land of the petitioners situated in village Anayatpur, tehsil Nowshera, district Rajouri has become subject matter of acquisition in terms of land acquisition award no.
Coll/Def/2020/881-85 dated 16.12.2020 passed by the Collector Land Acquisition Defence, Rajouri Poonch HQ Rajouri.
The acquisition so effected was initiated in terms of section 4 notification issued on 10.04.2019.
The passing of the acquisition award has taken place post Jammu & Kashmir Reorganization Act, 2019 coming into effect.

Mr. Jatinder Chouudhary, learned counsel for the petitioners refers to S.O. 3912 (E) dated 30.10.2019 to submit that the acquisition process so initiated under section 4 of the Jammu &
Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990 ought to have been translated into acquisition process under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 as per the mandate of S.O. 3912 (E) dated 30.10.2019 but the Collector has acted otherwise and renders his course of action nullity.
Prima facie case is made out.
